cohort: 389 pregnant patients with obstetrician-ordered allergy/immunology electronic consultations
finding: Penicillin allergy testing in pregnant patients was safe and associated with significantly reduced broad-spectrum antibiotic use and increased first-line beta-lactam antibiotic use.
mod_finding: Patients with in-person allergy evaluation had increased first-line antibiotic prophylaxis for both group B Streptococcus and cesarean section.
